verification.method: AI-assisted editorial comparison, not an independent human reviewer

claims.claim: The five relative environmental impacts and uncertainty intervals in our chart. High-meat group = 100%.
claims.limits: Not an individual causal forecast or a claim about this specific recipe. A group model, not an experimental diet switch.
claims.read_level: Publisher full-text page accessible; abstract figures and methods description compared. No raw-data reanalysis.
claims.locator: Abstract; Results; Methods. Relative impacts and 95% uncertainty intervals as reported in the abstract.

claims.claim: A well-planned vegan diet can be health-promoting for healthy adults under the stated conditions.
claims.limits: Not an individual diet plan or a blanket assurance for children, pregnancy or medical conditions.
claims.read_level: Official position landing page and summary read. Linked full PDF not newly appraised in Issue 03.
claims.locator: Position summary: healthy adults, B12 supplementation, adequate critical nutrients; limitations for vulnerable groups.

claims.claim: The default lentil-pasta base has an allocated ingredient cost of €0.6918478 per portion; three full packs cost €3.35.
claims.limits: Reference prices, not live offers. Not a complete meal; extra ingredients, energy, water and delivery excluded. One retailer is not a representative market.
claims.read_level: Six original retailer product pages opened via web retrieval; may be cached. Price, quantity and drained-weight basis extracted. No checkout or in-store purchase.
claims.locator: Each product URL appears in the interactive calculation and in products[].

chart.reference: High-meat group >=100 g meat/day = 100 for each indicator
chart.unit: Vegan group as percent of high-meat reference
chart.uncertainty: 95% uncertainty intervals, not a confidence score for the article

label.vi: Tác động đa dạng sinh học

retail_reference.method: Original retailer pages opened via web retrieval; responses may be cached. No live price API, checkout or in-store purchase.
retail_reference.drained_weight: Chickpeas: 220 g drained, not 350 g gross fill.

calculation.consumed_cost: grams_per_portion * portions / pack_g * price_eur, sum over ingredients
calculation.checkout: ceil(grams_per_portion * portions / pack_g) * price_eur, sum over unowned ingredients
calculation.pantry: Owned ingredients reduce checkout cost, not allocated consumed cost. Amount of existing pantry stock is not tracked.
calculation.rounding: Round final display totals only. CSV also includes unrounded quantities and costs to six decimal places.
limits: Recipe bases, not complete meals or nutrition plans
One retailer is not representative of a whole market
No payment for product inclusion or active affiliate links

corrections: feature.html#corrections opens a prefilled public GitHub issue draft; nothing auto-submitted.

photo.use: Illustrative stock photo; not a product test or photograph of the priced recipe. Original SVG illustration is the offline fallback.
